**D2 PR2b task mapping: net-tip-effect amendment slice (resolution.mjs only)**

**What**: Mapped the PR2b task slice (owner ruling #957, Option 2) into `openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/tasks.md` and `spec.md`, surgically extending owner's uncommitted edits without rewriting them.

**Where**:
- `tasks.md`: inserted a full "## PR 2b — Net-tip-effect amendment (`resolution.mjs` ONLY), ~100–140 counted lines" section between PR2's gate and PR3's header, with Phases 2b.1–2b.7 (RED-before-GREEN throughout):
  - 2b.1: closes a real gap — no A5 fixture (fresh non-revert-structured re-add) exists in `resolution.test.mjs` today despite old tasks.md Phase 2.2.5 claiming it was done; under the MERGED PR2 pairwise predicate this fixture actually returns `resolved:true` (wrong), not `false` as the stale prose claimed — this IS the A5 semantic flip owner condition 5 requires naming in the PR body.
  - 2b.2: `sign`/`netPresent`/rewritten `isResolvedAt` (directional net-parity, REQ-D2-16/REQ-D2-10), byte-for-byte `normDiff`/F-1 preserved, full PR2 regression re-run required.
  - 2b.3: `netAddFull` full-window primitive (groundwork only — NOT wired into brain-audit.mjs), retires pairwise `isReverterOf`.
  - 2b.4: A7 (THE CRITICAL, O/R/R2) — mutation bar is the MERGED PR2 predicate, not just `eff4560`.
  - 2b.5: A8 liveness (even chain settles).
  - 2b.6: C3 four range-boundary sub-fixtures (off-by-one both ends, offender-at-HEAD, live-readd-at-HEAD predicate-half, revert-cleanup-at-HEAD full-window half).
  - 2b.7: drift guards, PR-body A5-flip naming requirement, owner's own judgment-day gate (condition 4), budget check.
  - A9 (class-filtered [FAIL-SHA]) and all brain-audit.mjs wiring explicitly OUT OF SCOPE, deferred to PR3's rebase.
  - Added a `> DEFERRED REWORK NOTE` blockquote right after PR3's header (no checklist edits) flagging that PR3's existing Phase 3.1-3.4 checklist is now stale (references retired `isReverterOf`, missing REQ-D2-10a/-6b bindings) and requires its own rebase + judgment-day before resuming — explicitly NOT reworked in this pass per scope instruction.
  - Updated the top-level Review Workload Forecast table and dependency diagram to add PR2b (~100-140 lines, total chain ~780-820, still low risk everywhere).
- `spec.md`: updated intro blockquote chain line (5→6 PRs) and the Gate/Chain table — inserted the PR2b row bound to **REQ-D2-16 + amended REQ-D2-10**, updated PR3's row to explicitly bind **REQ-D2-10a (amended class filter) + REQ-D2-6(b) (amended coherence guard)** per instruction, updated cross-cutting/final chain-count sentences.

**Why**: Owner ruling #957 mandates PR2b as a doctrinal (not budget) foundation-before-consumer slice; sdd-tasks must map ONLY this slice now and explicitly defer PR3 detail until after PR2b merges and PR3 rebases.

**Learned**: Found tasks.md's own historical claim (checked-off Phase 2.2.5) doesn't match reality — a good example of doc/test drift going undetected because the checkbox was marked done without the fixture actually existing. Verified via grep of resolution.test.mjs (zero "A5"/"re-add" matches) before trusting the prose.

**Review Workload Forecast**: PR2b ≈100-140 counted lines (resolution.mjs only; resolution.test.mjs excluded via `governance.ignoreList`'s `**/*.test.mjs` entry, confirmed in brain.config.json). Low risk, no further chaining needed within PR2b itself. Chain remains 6 PRs total (PR1✓ PR2✓ PR2b PR3 PR4 PR5), stacked-to-main, no size:exception needed anywhere.

**Next**: sdd-apply on PR2b (resolution.mjs + resolution.test.mjs only). PR3 rebase is a SEPARATE future sdd-tasks/apply pass after PR2b merges + owner cold review + human merge.
